messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — APIGW 502/504 spike in eu-west-1. 1m error rate 12.4% (> threshold 3%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Autodetected surge starting 2024-11-09T02:46:39Z. Paging oncall.

alice: I’m oncall, looking now. can someone grab top traffic routes and recent deploys?

ben: I’ve pulled request logs. No deploys in the last 2 hours. Appears to be a backend timeout bubbling as 502s.

carla: routing table shows increased retries to model-backend-eu-2. Errors: upstream reset/timeout. sample logs:

```
[2024-11-09T02:48:12Z] proxy: request id=abcd1234 status=502 upstream_err=\"read timeout\"
[2024-11-09T02:48:15Z] proxy: request id=abcd1235 status=502 upstream_err=\"connection reset by peer\"
```

alice: ok. Can we check health endpoints? ben, can you run the health check across the pool?

ben: running quick check now:
```
$ for node in backend-{1..6}.eu; do curl -sS -m 2 http://$node/health || echo \"$node down\"; done
backend-1.eu OK
backend-2.eu OK
backend-3.eu OK
backend-4.eu OK
backend-5.eu OK
backend-6.eu OK
```
All nodes report OK at /health level.

carla: network traces show increased 5xx from model-inference-queueing on eu-side. Latencies spiking at the service mesh between apigw and backend-asm.

alice: likely queue saturation leading to upstream timeouts -> 502s. Immediate mitigations: 1) apply circuit breaker on high-QPS routes, 2) enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts, 3) reduce fanout to model-backend-eu-2.

dan: I’ll start with circuit breaker rule for /v1/generate and /v1/chat to fail-fast after 50ms of queued time. Pushing policy change now.

carla: policy change applied to edge: 
```
-broker config set circuit_breaker:/v1/generate threshold=50ms action=error_rate_fallback
-broker config set circuit_breaker:/v1/chat threshold=50ms action=error_rate_fallback
```

alice: :white_check_mark: circuit breaker is live. Observability: starting to see drop in backend queue depth.

ben: also scaled up apigw worker pool by +30% (temporary). Command: `k scale apigw-workers --replicas=130` done.

carla: routing rule activated to send 10% of traffic to us-east as regional fallback. config:
```
route-decision: if error_rate > 5% then split(90% eu-west, 10% us-east)
```

alice: good. Collecting customer impact: dashboard shows 11% of user requests in EU are getting 502s during the surge window. Top affected customers: acme-inc (5% of their sessions), beta-app (2.1%). No rolling crediting yet.

sre-manager: escalate to incident response if impact crosses 15% or persists >30m. Right now we are at 12.4% and 20m elapsed. Keep updates every 5m.

ben: metrics update (02:57Z): error rate down to 7.3% after circuit breaker + scale. Backend queue length halved. Latency p50 edge -> 120ms -> 95ms.

carla: I’m seeing some error signatures indicating HTTP/2 connection resets from our internal LB to backend-3. Marking backend-3 for deeper investigation, will open a debug session.

alice: marking backend-3 traffic to 0 for now (drain). Command: `lb migrate backend-3 weight=0 drain=true`

ben: drain in progress. Also toggled aggressive retry backoff to avoid thundering herd: `retries max=1 backoff=250ms`.

carla: after draining backend-3 and circuit breaker, error rate now 3.1% (03:05Z). Latency normalizing.

alice: great. Begin customer comms draft: \"We experienced elevated 502 errors in EU region between 02:46-03:06 UTC, impacting some requests. Mitigations applied and system stabilized. Investigating root cause with infra team.\" Will post on status page after approval.

sre-manager: leave a note for follow-up RCA: include queueing telemetry, connection reset traces, and why backend-3 degraded. Assign to carla and ben.

dan: taking 1hr follow-up oncall to monitor post-mitigation. Handing off to dan at 03:10Z. alice will be reachable for questions.

alice: handing off. I’ll update postmortem with timeline. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as MITIGATED at 2024-11-09T03:12:00Z. Final 10m error rate 1.8%.

carla: quick note — backend-3 shows intermittent NIC errors, NIC replaced in maintenance window. Scheduling deeper infra check.

ben: leaving the circuit breaker config as-is for 30m then rollback if stable.

sre-manager: thanks everyone. please add any logs/links to the postmortem doc. Closing the live channel, keep the incident record open for RCA. :v:
